header.name: Comprehensive Gender Sensitization
header.description: This course aims to develop a deepere understanding of key concepts, ideas and issues pertaining to gender. The course focusses on cultivating a better understanding of issues pertaining to gender based discrimination and gendered violence. The course aims to foster a gender sensitive perspective among students.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To state key concepts in gender and sexuality education

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: To apply the understanding of gender and sexuality in different contexts

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: To analyse legal provisions and remedies contextually.

lecture_topics: Rights, Laws and Redressal. (Institutional-Workplace/Educational Institutions, POSH Act, ICC)

resources.title: Key concepts in gender studies- Jane Pilcher and Imelda Whelehan
